static_acceptance: The candidate differs from control only on a current-visible frame already eligible under the frozen adaptive gate.

Candidate target equals30+8*d*m, remains greater than or equal to control and never exceeds38; control and candidate reconverge exactly on the excluded side of every gate boundary. Inclusive sweep6 and absolute steering0.28 remain eligible.
Steering, detector, pass-side, latch and shared inherited state remain exact except _pace_command_target and derived _pace_effective_target.
Both turn directions and both obstacle sides receive symmetric surface coverage.
Pedal boundaries, intermediate targets, target hierarchy, finite bounds and gas/brake exclusivity match the registered formulas.
Far-to-near, increasing severity, steering-veto, detector miss1--4, fifth clear, reacquisition, flicker and reset sequences reconverge outside the eligible frame.
Randomized independent and stateful differential coverage proves every difference is eligible and bounded.
Affected controller, inference, local-contract and submission suites pass.
An isolated package passes exact-file import, reset, finite-action, bounds and latency smoke without modifying root submission.zip.
rollback: Any target above38, below control or at/above40.
